summary: Iteration 16 testing complete. All features verified: Explore/Stores page now pulls brands from MongoDB brands collection instead of hardcoded data. Floor filter, category filter, and search all work correctly against DB data. 102 brands displayed with proper name, category, floor, and logo_url fields.
passed_tests: API: GET /api/consumer/stores returns 102 brands from MongoDB with proper fields (name, category, floor, logo_url)
API: GET /api/consumer/stores?floor=Food%20Court returns 21 Food Court brands
API: GET /api/consumer/stores?floor=Ground%20Floor returns Ground Floor brands
API: GET /api/consumer/stores?search=star returns Starbucks (Cafe, Ground Floor)
API: Stores endpoint returns categories and floors filter options
API: Brand logos use Google CDN URLs (80+ brands)
API: GET /api/consumer/participating-brands returns 102 brands with filters
API: GET /api/consumer/home returns featured stores and banners
API: POST /api/consumer/auth/verify-otp works with OTP 1234 (dev mode)
API: Invalid OTP (9999) correctly rejected with 400 status
Frontend: Stores page loads with 'Explore Stores' header
Frontend: Shows '102 brands at CP67 Mall' count
Frontend: Floor dropdown filter works (Food Court shows 21 brands)
Frontend: Category pill filter works (Fashion shows 37 brands)
Frontend: Search works (Starbucks found for 'starbucks' search)
Frontend: Store cards display name, category, floor tag, and logo

Stores.jsx fetchStores() correctly calls /api/consumer/stores with query params

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 verified the Explore/Stores page fix. The stores endpoint now queries the brands collection (not deprecated stores collection). Key implementation: list_stores() at line ~591 in consumer.py builds query with category, floor, search filters and returns stores with proper structure. The _enrich_brands() function runs at startup to fill in floor/category from BRAND_DIRECTORY for brands that were imported via admin Excel upload. 102 brands total, with proper floor distribution: Ground Floor, First Floor, Second Floor, Food Court, Lower Ground.
